project_name.justification: The text refers to the project as the 'Lennac Lake Property' and the 'Lennac Lake Project' throughout the documents.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Goldhills Holding Ltd. (TSXV:GHL) (OTCQB: GODZF) (Frankfurt: GRYA) (“Goldhills” or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies 'Steven Sangha' as a 'Director', but does not mention a CEO for the buyer, Goldhills Holding Ltd.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement 'grants Goldhills the option to acquire a 100% interest in the Lennac Lake Property'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as being in the 'Babine Copper – Moly Porphyry district' and drilling is intended 'to confirm the presence of copper'.

verified_article_link.justification: The second article is about the Lennac Lake project and provides a source link at the bottom: 'To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/220276'.

currency.justification: A future payment is specified as '$40,000 CDN per annum', indicating the currency is Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of the scheduled payments: '$10,000 upon signing, $20,000 by the first anniversary, $30,000 by the second anniversary, and $40,000 by the third anniversary of the agreement', which totals $100,000.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration is explicitly broken down into cash payments and exploration commitments, not a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any issuance of shares as part of the consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in options.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issued share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions a plan for 'approximately 2800 meters of drilling', but the formal option agreement specifies a monetary exploration commitment, not a meterage one.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The total exploration commitment is the sum of the required milestone expenditures: '$75,000 by the first anniversary, an additional $100,000 by the second anniversary, and an additional $200,000 by the third anniversary', which totals $375,000.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement specifies an 'annual payment in lieu of a net smelter return royalty', not an actual Net Smelter Royalty.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The property subject to the option agreement is 'comprised of three contiguous blocks covering a total area of 970.897 ha'. Subsequent land acquisitions by staking are separate from this transaction.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the area is specified in the text: '...a total area of 970.897 ha...'

resource_size.justification: The text describes the project as an 'early exploration project' and mentions confirmed mineralization, but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate in terms of tonnes, ounces, or pounds.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the text: 'Goldhills Holding Ltd. (TSXV:GHL)'.
